profile.headline: Software Engineer at Twitch
profile.summary: Computer Science graduate from the University of Puerto Rico at Bayamon. I enjoy gaming, esports, programming and Web Development. Currently Software Engineer at Twitch.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Work on developing new features, internal tools and maintenance for the home care platform. React + Django.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Work on developing new features for the podcasting platform. Django, JS, JQuery.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Research on Indoor localization using Wi-Fi Technology and Bluetooth Low-Energy (BLE) Beacons.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on implementation of SCORM compliance for an e-learning platform.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Research on developing a platform for visualization of VLBI sessions for radio observatories.

honors.title: 2nd Place in the Puerto Rico Game Jam
First place at the Startup Weekend
honors.description: First place for being part of the development of startup company Cheap PC, focused on reducing e-waste through recycling unused or broken computers and parts with the aim of repairing them to be new functional PC's, which are sold at a low cost.
honors.issuer: Issued by Startup Weekend Puerto Rico · Jan 2015
